performance_issues.description: ListEntriesRecursiveWithSize can return very large result sets for repos with many files
performance_issues.impact: Memory spike when listing all entries recursively before pagination is applied
performance_issues.recommendation: All entries are loaded into memory before pagination slice is applied. Consider streaming or limiting recursion depth.

optimization_recommendations.description: Apply pagination at git level rather than loading all entries first
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce memory usage for large trees from O(n) to O(page_size)
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use git ls-tree with pagination support or limit recursion
